items.raw_excerpt: Maior centro de tratamento gratuito de câncer da América Latina, localizado em Barretos (SP), expande serviços para pacientes com câncer
items.summary_en: The largest free cancer treatment center in Latin America is in Barretos, Brazil. It has expanded its services with a new wing for cancer patient rehabilitation. The center keeps growing to help more patients.

items.raw_excerpt: Emily Scolyer says her family will be honouring their father's love and special memories this Father’s Day.
items.summary_en: Richard Scolyer gave his daughter Emily a love she says will last forever. This Father's Day, Emily and her family will honour their father's special memories and the bond they shared.
items.summary_ko: Richard Scolyer는 딸 Emily에게 영원히 남을 사랑을 선물했습니다. 이번 아버지날, Emily와 가족들은 아버지의 특별한 추억과 그들이 나눈 유대를 기념할 예정입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Malappuram DDC urges the Centre to reconsider the split of the Palakkad rail division, citing negative impacts on local services.
items.summary_en: The Malappuram District Development Commissioner has urged the central government to reconsider its decision to split the Palakkad rail division. Officials say the split would negatively impact local train services and commuters. The district is requesting the original rail division be kept intact.
items.summary_ko: 말라푸람 지역개발위원장이 중앙정부에 팔카드 철도분할 결정을 재고해달라고 요청했습니다. 이번 분할로 인해 해당 지역 열차 서비스와 통근자들이 악영향을 받을 것으로 우려됩니다. 지방정부는 기존 철도분할 구조를 유지해달라고 호소하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Malappuram District Official Asks Central Government to Reverse Palakkad Rail Division Split
items.title_ko: 말라푸람 구청장, 중앙정부에 팔카드 철도분할 철회 요청

items.raw_excerpt: The exclusive bee species in the Himalayas, Apis laboriosa, builds large exposed honeycombs on cliffs that can be above 4 kilometres above sea level.

items.raw_excerpt: NHAI tests reclaimed bitumen technology on Chennai-Tirupathi Highway, increasing sustainable road construction by utilizing 60% recycled asphalt.

items.raw_excerpt: It doesn’t get much more charming than Stockholm, Wisconsin. On any given day, visitors likely outnumber residents.
items.summary_en: Stockholm is a tiny village in Wisconsin with only about 84 people living there. On any given day, tourists and visitors outnumber the actual residents. The small town is known for its charming Scandinavian heritage and small-town appeal.

items.raw_excerpt: Le festival Fort Fort Lointain revient à l’hippodrome de Parilly, à Bron, près de Lyon, ce week-end pour deux jours d'événements autour du thème fantastique.
